name: Hyperparameter Optimization & Tuning
description: Automated hyperparameter search strategies: Grid Search, Random Search, Bayesian Optimization (Optuna, Hyperopt, TPE), early stopping pruning, Multi-Fidelity tuning, and learning rate scheduling.

subskills.name: Grid Search & Randomized Search
subskills.description: Exhaustive parameter grids with GridSearchCV, RandomizedSearchCV probability distributions, budget allocation, and search space definition.

subskills.name: Bayesian Optimization & Optuna TPE Sampler
subskills.description: Tree-structured Parzen Estimators (TPE), Gaussian Process surrogate models, Expected Improvement (EI), and study optimization with Optuna.

subskills.name: Early Stopping & Automated Trial Pruning
subskills.description: Median pruner, Hyperband, Successive Halving (ASHA), trial.should_prune(), and terminating unpromising hyperparameter trials early.

subskills.name: Learning Rate Schedulers & Warmup Dynamics
subskills.description: Cosine Annealing, OneCycleLR, ExponentialLR, ReduceLROnPlateau, linear warmup steps, and cyclic learning rates.

subskills.name: Multi-Objective Hyperparameter Optimization
subskills.description: Pareto frontiers, simultaneously optimizing accuracy vs latency vs model size, and non-dominated sorting in Optuna.

subskills.name: Distributed Hyperparameter Tuning (Ray Tune)
subskills.description: Scaling tuning across clusters using Ray Tune, population-based training (PBT), distributed trial scheduling, and checkpoint synchronization.

subskills.name: Search Space Design & Parameter Sensitivity
subskills.description: Log-scale sampling for learning rates/regularization, categorical choices, conditional hyperparameter spaces, and Sobol sensitivity analysis.

subskills.name: Nested Cross-Validation for Hyperparameter Selection
subskills.description: Inner loop for hyperparameter tuning, outer loop for unbiased generalization performance estimation, and avoiding optimism bias.

subskills.name: HPO Experiment Tracking & Sweep Logging (W&B, MLflow)
subskills.description: Logging hyperparameter sweeps in Weights & Biases (W&B) or MLflow, parallel coordinates plots, correlation charts, and artifact linking.

cv.signal: Implemented Bayesian hyperparameter tuning with Optuna and Ray Tune, improving model AUC while halving compute costs

linkedin.signal: Hyperparameter Optimization, Optuna, and Ray Tune endorsements

assessment.signal: Passes Hyperparameter Optimization & Tuning Technical Assessment

junior.description: Performs grid and random searches, configures learning rate schedulers (Cosine/ReduceLROnPlateau), and tracks runs in MLflow/W&B.

mid.description: Conducts Bayesian optimization with Optuna TPE samplers, configures ASHA/Hyperband pruning, and performs nested cross-validation.

senior.description: Architects multi-objective Pareto optimization (accuracy vs latency) and scales distributed hyperparameter sweeps across clusters with Ray Tune.
